第479章 天才战生死斗（第1页）
旋即，忍不住拍了拍许小凡的肩膀。
“真是什么好事，都让你小子给赶上了。”
许小凡不由挠了挠头，感觉有些莫名其妙。
可丝毫没有觉得自己遇见过什么好事。
许小凡见到来人，不由兴高采烈道。
“为父不在时，可有发生什么事？”
许小凡简短的将事情的来龙去脉说了一遍。
说到最后，他又叹了口气，担忧道：
“爹，苍梧界几大巅峰势力，咱们一次性得罪了两个，以后的日子，恐怕不会安生了。”
许渊说罢，将手中的几枚空间戒指直接丢给了许小凡。
他打算再为许族的逼格，继续添砖加瓦。
“从族中随便拿了点......”
“你爹我还没死呢，你就打遗产的主意了？”
“放心，你乃我许族少族长，总有一天，我许族的担子，需要你来扛，只是现在，你还扛不住，为父暂时帮你扛一段时间罢了。”
“毕竟，未来都是你们年轻人的。”
一旁的石皓月默默听着父子二人的谈话。
“爹，咱许族，难道就没有其他的年轻一辈了？”

“我许族上一代倒是繁荣，不过到了我这一代，却只有你这一个了。”
许小凡闻言，一时不知是该哭还是该笑了。
许渊旋即又指了指其中一枚空间戒指道：
“这枚空间戒指之中，有许多蕴含着混沌之气的混沌石。”
“是为父在一处不可知之地寻得，或许对你的修行有所帮助。”
许小凡打开那枚空间戒指看了一眼。
他能感觉到，这混沌石内蕴含的混沌之气极为浓郁。
正好对他修行神魔炼气诀有所帮助！
许渊此时则将目光看向一旁的石皓月。
“敢问公主，不知宇宙天才战，还有多久？”
闻言，石皓月不由诧异的看了一眼许渊。
石皓月得到确切的答案，却不惊讶。
宇宙天才战是苍梧界独有，其他大千世界不存在。
许族，也极有可能，是其他大千世界的超级存在。
所以许渊没有参加过宇宙天才战，并不奇怪。
“宇宙天才战，乃是由几大巅峰存在牵头，所举办的宇宙盛事。”
“这些巨头们认为，胜败乃兵家常事，谁才是真正的天才，并非一场决斗能决定的。”
“所以，宇宙天才战并非传统的擂台战，而是一场为期十年的生死斗！”

Chapter 479 Geniuses fight to the death (page 1)
Immediately, he couldn't help but pat Xu Xiaofan on the shoulder.
"It's such a good thing that you have caught up with me."
Xu Xiaofan couldn't help scratching his head, feeling a little baffled.
But I didn’t feel that I had encountered anything good at all.
Xu Xiaofan couldn't help but said happily when he saw the visitor.
"Did anything happen when my father was away?"
Xu Xiaofan briefly explained the whole story.
At the end, he sighed again and said worriedly:
"Dad, we have offended two of the top forces in Cangwu Realm at once. I am afraid we will not be able to live peacefully in the future."
After Xu Yuan finished speaking, he threw several space rings in his hand directly to Xu Xiaofan.
He plans to continue to contribute to the Xu clan's strong character.
"I just took some from the clan..."
"I haven't even died yet, your father, and you're planning on inheriting it?"
"Don't worry, you are the young leader of my Xu clan. One day, you will need to carry the burden of my Xu clan. But right now, you can't carry it, so I will help you carry it for a while as my father."
"After all, the future belongs to you young people."
Shi Haoyue on the side listened silently to the conversation between father and son.
"Dad, don't we have any other younger generation in the Xu clan?"
"My Xu clan was prosperous in the previous generation, but in my generation, you are the only one."
When Xu Xiaofan heard this, he didn't know whether to cry or laugh.
Xu Yuan immediately pointed to one of the space rings and said:
"In this space ring, there are many chaos stones containing the energy of chaos."
"I found it for my father in an unknown place. It may be helpful to your practice."
Xu Xiaofan opened the space ring and took a look.
He could feel that the chaos energy contained in this chaos stone was extremely rich.
It just happened to be helpful for him to practice the God and Demon Qi Refining Technique!
At this time, Xu Yuan looked at Shi Haoyue aside.
"I dare to ask, princess, how long will it take for the battle between geniuses in the universe?"
Hearing this, Shi Haoyue couldn't help but glance at Xu Yuan in surprise.
Shi Haoyue got the exact answer, but was not surprised.
The battle of cosmic geniuses is unique to the Cangwu world and does not exist in other worlds.
The Xu clan is also very likely to be a super being in other worlds.
Therefore, it is not surprising that Xu Yuan has not participated in the Space Genius Battle.
"The Cosmic Genius Battle is a cosmic event led by several peak beings."
"These giants believe that victory or defeat is a matter of military strategism, and who is the real genius cannot be determined by a duel."
"So, the Cosmic Genius Battle is not a traditional arena battle, but a ten-year life-and-death battle!"
